items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Ulysses Livingston was the guitar player

ctx.x: had exams, and he said, just six weeks. Come on and go.

So I rehearsed with them a few days, and the -- Ulysses Livingston was the guitar player, and Preston -- what was Preston's name? He's a trumpet player. Eddie Preston, a trumpet player, and we all went over there and -- together, about six or seven of us.

And this was in '47. And most of them, we -- in fact, we didn't get paid because, when we went, we didn't know that C. P. Johnson, the leader, had a narcotics charge on him here, back here in L. A., so he'd written and gotten most of the money advanced so he could get enough, buy enough time to go over there and do those jobs.
